Name: Larger Beach Farm Map
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Replaces the Beach Farm with a larger map. 

Includes another small crop area where sprinklers work.

In order to enable sprinklers, run the game, and then open the config.json in the mod folder and put "True" in the "SprinklerFriendly" field! By default, this is turned off.

In order to change the stepping stone paths to connecting land, run the game, and then open the config.json and put "True" in the "ConnectingLand" option. By default, this is turned off!

In order to remove the formerly unremovable debris at the bottom from vanilla, run the game, and then open the config.json and put "False" in the "Debris" option. By default, this is turned on.
